# Generated from the graph: do not edit

Everything in this folder is produced by the exporter from `../graph/MiEdWorkforce.ttl`. Edits here are lost the next time it runs. To change a doc, change the graph (or the export template) and regenerate.

This folder is the diff target for the parity check: compare it against `../working-docs/` (and, for the original state, the `baseline-docs` git tag) with a visual diff tool. Once a domain is clean, this folder becomes the new baseline.

Regenerate from the editor folder:

```bash
node scripts/export-docs.ts credentialing
```
